sentences.text: Appearance:
Ms. Ayushi Yadav - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri APS Tomar - Public Prosecutor for the State.
 ORDER
The present application, filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. (corresponding to Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023), is the first one seeking grant of bail.

The applicant has been in custody since 22.09.2025 in connection with Crime No.123/2025 registered at Police Station Chinnore, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) 376(3), 506 of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Kidnapping, rape and the offence under the POCSO Act is alleged against the applicant in respect of minor prosecutrix, who is aged around 18 years.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is contended that the prosecutrix and the applicant were in a consensual relationship for the past several years.

The family members of the prosecutrix were aware of this relationship, and upon NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:27907 2 MCRC-49139-2025 recently learning of it, her father objected to the same and allegedly compelled her to lodge a false report against the applicant.
It is further argued that there is a substantial and unexplained delay in the lodging of the FIR.

The alleged incidents are stated to have occurred on 28.02.2023 and during Shivratri 2024, whereas the present FIR came to be registered only on 21.09.2025, i.e., after more than one and a half years from the first alleged incident and several months after the second.

sentences.text: prolonged and unexplained delay in filing the report, it is submitted, casts serious doubt on the genuineness and credibility of the prosecution version.
It is further submitted that the allegations levelled against the applicant are exaggerated and stem from familial pressure rather than any genuine grievance.
It is urged that the relationship between the parties was voluntary and based on mutual affection.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents and has cooperated fully with the investigation.
It is further submitted that looking to the mental status of the prosecutrix, it is apparent that she is an adult with the capacity to understand and make informed decisions.

She is mentally mature enough to comprehend the proceedings of the trial, and there is no evidence to suggest that her mental condition renders her vulnerable or incapable of protecting her own interests.
Considering the same, there is no likelihood of any prejudice or harm occurring to her if the applicant is granted bail.
The applicant is a permanent resident of District Gwalior, and therefore, there is no likelihood of his tampering with evidence or influencing witnesses if released on bail.
The trial is likely to take considerable time for its conclusion.
The applicant undertakes to strictly abide by any conditions that NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:27907 3 MCRC-49139-2025 this Court may deem fit to impose while granting bail.
In view of the foregoing, a prayer has been made for the grant of regular bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor/Panel Lawyer for the State had opposed the application and had prayed for its rejection in view of the gravity of the offence.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that the trial is likely to take considerable time for its conclusion, and bearing in mind that prolonged pre-trial incarceration militates against the fundamental right to personal liberty, and further, there being no material to indicate any likelihood of the applicant absconding or tampering with the prosecution evidence, this Court finds it fit and proper to extend the benefit of bail to the applicant.

Accordingly,
without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court, subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
1.
The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;

2. The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/trial, as the case may be;
3.

The applicant will not indulge himself in extending inducement, threat or promise t o a n y p e r s o n a c q u a i n t e d w i t h t h e N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N N O .
